version: synthetic original report; newly supplied body excerpt

segments.text: This is the report underlying the 180-applicant eight-week survey abstract. Portal reuse meant any self-reported later visit, with or without help, during weeks two to eight. It did not measure independent completion separately. Assisted appointment attendance was not collected.

Greater perceived procedural complexity was associated with less self-reported reuse after adjustment for prior internet use. Adjusted estimates and intervals are in the supplementary regression table, which is not included in this excerpt. Applicants unavailable at follow-up were excluded.
